newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal to sell 30 pct EDP in first phase.
newsitem.headline: Portugal to sell 30 pct EDP in first phase.

text.p: The first phase of the privatisation of state electricity concern EDP was unlikely to run to more than 30 percent of the company, its chairman said on Wednesday.
It would be unrealistic to try and sell more, Antonio de Almeida told a news conference to launch a publicity campaign aimed at attracting Portuguese investors.
The government has said that it wants to sell between 20 and 30 percent but would be prepared to go as high as 49 percent if demand were there.
With EDP valued at some 1.5 trillion escudos, the sale, which is set for early June, will be the largest privatisation yet carried out in Portugal.
A banking source close to the deal said that the cabinet would decide final details of the sale at a meeting on Thursday.
